Corollary
[Liouville theorem] Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0056, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0057 1. ch3:3.12\group ch03-classical-maximum-principle An entire solution of a uniformly elliptic equation $au_{xx}+2bu_{xy}+cu_{yy}=0$ on $\mathbb R^2$ that is bounded on one side is constant.
Proof

\sketch Subtract the infimum and choose $z_0$ with $u(z_0)<\varepsilon $. The disk estimate (3.21), whose constant is scale independent, bounds $u$ by $K\varepsilon $ on every fixed point after taking a sufficiently large disk. Let $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$.

□
